7297957.sourceDescription: Bring the festive magic to your home with this freestanding LED cone tree that's ready to set up and enjoy during the festive season. It's designed to be assembled and dressed instantly, giving you more time to enjoy the celebrations and less time wrestling with complicated decorations. The rainbow-coloured lights cascade down the cone shape, twinkling and gleaming to create a colourful display that adds festive charm to any space. zvat5n70.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Ultra-Lit Potted Montecito Spruce Christmas Tree
zvat5n70.sourceDescription: Are you looking for a luxury, ultra realistic Christmas tree this year? You're in luck! Our glamorous 8ft Ultra-Lit Potted Montecito Spruce pulls out all the stops to delight guests and homeowners. With a natural-looking, upswept look, realistic plastic moulded branches, and 100% PE branch tips, this luxury artificial Christmas tree is a serious favourite here at CTW HQ. Not to mention the pre-attached 'micro' LEDs. As the name suggests, they are smaller than normal Christmas lights on pre-lit trees and provide a brighter, bedazzling display. Hoping to save on the faff? You've got it here, as this 8ft Christmas tree is powered by the trunk slotting together. This unique lighting system not only makes assembly much simpler, but it also helps to keep cables out of sight. Plus, it comes with an attractive pot to save on buying a tree skirt. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. xkm15qjc.baseName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
xkm15qjc.variantName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
xkm15qjc.sourceDescription: This artificial Christmas tree brings modern flair and festivity to any living room or outdoor space. With a cone-shaped structure and vibrant green hue, it offers the classic beauty of a real tree without the mess. Its rough texture mimics the natural feel, enhancing the seasonal atmosphere wherever it's placed. The tree effortlessly integrates into a modern home, offering a serene backdrop for gatherings and quiet evenings alike. Durable Plastic Construction Crafted from high-quality plastic, the tree structure ensures it stands firm and resists tipping over. The material is selected not only for its resilience but also for the way it mimics natural greenery, bringing an authentic touch to your holiday decorating. Maintenance is straightforward; simply avoid prolonged exposure to sunlight to keep it looking vibrant. Integrated String Lights The tree comes adorned with decorative string lights, featuring LED bulbs that offer a warm white glow. These lights are energy-efficient, eliminating the need for replacing bulbs frequently. Each strand is strategically placed to evenly illuminate the tree, enhancing your holiday joy without the hassle of tangled wires. Practical USB Power Source Designed with modern convenience in mind, the tree's LED lights are powered by a USB connection. This feature allows you to easily position the tree wherever desired, without worrying about proximity to traditional power outlets. Its universal compatibility makes it an ideal choice for integrating into different room setups. Versatile Seasonal Décor Suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, it's perfect for enhancing various spaces during the holiday season. Its modern style complements contemporary decors, effortlessly adding a festive cheer to both private and public spaces, such as living rooms, offices, or sheltered patios. Simple Assembly Following the manufacturer's instructions ensures a hassle-free setup with minimal tools required -scissors suffice for the task. Once assembled, it commands attention with its sleek design, crafting a quintessential Christmas focal point in any setting. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 115 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 930 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 6 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 3 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

azffnjf2.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. jczd8kj8.baseName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Verdant Green
jczd8kj8.variantName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Verdant Green
jczd8kj8.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
